tool_signatures.name: sakura_spots
tool_signatures.description: Use this when the user already knows the prefecture and needs exact cherry blossom viewing spots with current status and GPS coordinates. Each spot uses JMC reporter observations as the primary status when filed within the last 48 hours (states: pre-bloom through hazakura/green leaves); falls back to the JMC bloom-meter estimate otherwise, with any stale observation shown as secondary context. Also returns the prefecture's JMA reference station summary. Do not use this for nationwide timing comparisons or date matching; use sakura_forecast or sakura_best_dates first.
